art.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Produce ONE original full-color comic master image, landscape 3:2 ratio, EXACTLY SIX equally sized panels in a rigid 3 columns × 2 rows grid, thin black panel borders at exactly thirds and half. No outer title band, no page margin. Every panel fills its cell, independently cropped later for mobile. NO LETTERS, NO TEXT, NO SPEECH BUBBLES, NO CAPTIONS, NO LOGOS. References: first image fixes both characters' faces and proportions; second fixes October clothing only. Match the original expressive manga ink-and-watercolor comic style, varied line weights and lively acting. Hugo adult brown hair short beard teal eyes, rust overshirt, black shirt, pumpkin pin, very oversized charcoal trousers, cream sneakers, dark left-wrist watch. iAstro child android HUMAN FACE black spiky hair black eyes cyan temple detail and heart on chest, white tunic purple shorts dark tights white-purple boots, little purple Halloween cape. Keep head axes generally upright, vary profile, front, three-quarter, wide shots and closeups; expressive big open mouths, eyebrows, gestures. Hugo generally left, iAstro right. Warm wooden workshop with round window and autumn leaves outside. Maintain clear anatomy, only these two recurring people, no real public figures. Preserve exact identity and outfits across all six panels. Story: building a birdhouse through parallel work. SIX PANELS IN ORDER: (1) wide workshop, Hugo left struggles with three enormous rolls of plans and a small unfinished wooden birdhouse, mouth agape; iAstro right observes. (2) medium iAstro confidently distributes three blank colored task cards into three trays on a workbench; Hugo nods. (3) wide elevated view of three separate whimsical tabletop machines simultaneously making a blueprint drawing, sorting wood pieces, and calculating with a tiny abacus; the duo oversee, no additional characters. (4) close-up, Hugo and iAstro check three progress cards with simple unlettered icons and tick marks, both heads upright. (5) low angle outdoors, they together proudly mount the finished small birdhouse on a tree with fall leaves. (6) comic punchline, an enormous round pigeon sits on top of the tiny birdhouse, Hugo stunned open mouth at left, iAstro amused points at the oversized bird on right. This is an imaginary metaphor, NOT documentation of a real product.
